column2: Well, well! It seems our problem $$奴隷$$ has returned!
Let him go... Let go of his hand!!
We have no wish to use force against one of our fellow people with black $$羽$$!
Young lady!
But if you insist on refusing to treat a $$奴隷$$ like a $$奴隷$$...
and continue letting him roam free without even a $$首輪$$...
then he'll have to die!!
According to the rumors, even if you $$猫っ可愛がり$$ your $$奴隷$$ like a $$ペット$$,
isn't dressing him in clothes going too far?!
H-he's nothing like that!!
It's your choice if you form an $$執着心$$ to your own $$奴隷$$, but!
Ah, I see!!
A cup you didn't like when someone first gave it to you...
starts to seem better after you use it every day. Is that it?!
N-no! He's not a $$ペット$$...
or a $$ヌイグルミ$$...!
I $$愛$$ him—
Ah!!
$$愛$$, you say?!
That's merely a misunderstanding caused by the human $$発情期$$—the thing people call $$恋$$, even in this $$世界$$!
When any animal enters $$発情期$$, its heart races and $$血$$ rushes to its head...
and it sometimes shouts things that make no sense.
In that case, you should simply do whatever you like with him!!
You mustn't be ashamed of feeling $$欲情$$ for your $$奴隷$$!
To feel $$欲情$$ for someone...
is a primal act tied to preservation of the $$種族$$ in every animal!
Besides...
to speak of a fantasy called $$愛$$, something that doesn't actually exist in $$この世$$,
don't you know that's one of the $$七つの大罪$$?!
